name: Pint-Sized Slasher Masks
blurb: Every known spawn location for the Pint-Sized Slasher Masks, grouped by region.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location, face south and follow the road, past the park, and stop in the middle of the wooden bridge. Face west and jump off the bridge into the water. Follow the water until you see a white boat on your right. The phantom's corpse is inside the boat cabin.

spawns.label: Spawn 2
spawns.directions: From Spawn 1, exit the boat cabin and walk around the edge of the boat until you are standing at the front. Now spread your arms like you're in Titanic and don't sink. Joking — face north and walk towards the park. Enter the park and continue north, with the roller coaster on your right. Follow the path around until you reach the entrance of The Widow Maker. Face south and follow the path up the ramp until you are standing on the ride. Face south and walk along the roller coaster track until you reach the first car at the top, where the phantom's corpse is sitting.

spawns.label: Spawn 3
spawns.directions: From Spawn 2, face south and continue to follow the ride around until you get to the next set of cars; the phantom's corpse is sitting in the car at the end.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location, face south and walk up the ramp in front of you, then follow the path around. Stop at the end, face south, and jump over the railing to the ground. Face north and the phantom's corpse should be in front of you, leaning against the porta-potty.

locations.note: I hate fast travelling and doubling back on my routes, so these directions start from the Rollins Labor Camp spawn. If you'd rather start from the Nuka-World on Tour fast travel point, you should still be able to find all the spawns using the images below.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the Rollins Labor Camp spawn, face east and run straight, past the labor camp, and stop when you reach the main road and the T-junction. Continue heading east along the road until you reach the Nuka-World on Tour entrance. Take the entrance on the far left and turn left on the other side. The phantom's corpse will be down at your feet in front of you.

spawns.label: Spawn 2
spawns.directions: From Spawn 1, face north and you will see a red and white brick-lined path slightly to your right. Walk over and follow the path north, then stop at the Hoop Toss mini-game on your left. The phantom's corpse is on the ground behind the bench. You will need to either jump the fence or open the gate on the right side to access the mask.

spawns.label: Spawn 3
spawns.directions: Fast travel to the Nuka-World on Tour map marker. From the spawn-in location, turn south-west and run straight until you reach the pink and red brick-lined path. Turn left onto the path and follow it up the hill until you reach the large glowing Nuka-Cola Quantum bottle on your left. A few steps past the bottle, turn left and walk over to the 'you must be this tall to ride' sign. Turn left and take the ramp on the right up to the top. The phantom's corpse will be at your feet.

locations.note: I would run ahead and clear the area, then fast travel back to Dino Peaks Mini Golf to put you back at the spawn-in location — it makes it easier to follow the directions to each corpse.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location, face north and run forward, under the Dino Peaks sign, and then turn left. Follow the path around, going past hole 1. Go up the ramp and head towards the headless dinosaur at hole 3. The phantom's corpse will be on the second bench on your left.

spawns.label: Spawn 2
spawns.directions: From Spawn 1, go back to the hole 3 sign and face north. Walk forward towards the white shed at the back, and the phantom's corpse will be on the ground near the main entrance, inside the dinosaur jaw.

spawns.label: Spawn 3
spawns.directions: From Spawn 2, face south and walk forward until you reach the picnic table with the radio on it. Face east and follow the path up the ramp and around to the right until you get to hole 4. Face south and follow hole 4 to the end, then keep walking straight until you get to the jeep on the edge of the cliff. The phantom's corpse is inside the jeep.

spawns.label: Spawn 4
spawns.directions: Fast travel back to Dino Peaks Mini Golf so you are standing back at the spawn-in location. Face south, turn right, and then follow the road for a while — past Pebbles the Cat Museum, past the bus, and over the bridge. Slow down once you are past the bridge and walk slowly while looking to the right. The phantom's corpse is lying in front of the Strouds Run State Park sign on your right.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the Prospect Hill spawn-in location, face north-east and run over to the Starlight Drive-in Workshop. Stop when you get to the main road and turn left. Follow the road until you get to the main entrance of the drive-in on your right. Face east and follow the road on the left. Stop at the ticket booth on your right, and the phantom's corpse will be sitting inside the ticket booth.

spawns.label: Spawn 2
spawns.directions: From Spawn 1, face north-east and walk forward, jumping over the small green fence, and enter the playground. The phantom's corpse is leaning out of the window of the UFO jungle gym in front of you.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location, run straight ahead, and the phantom's corpse is lying on the white wooden lounge chair in front of you.

spawns.label: Spawn 2
spawns.directions: From Spawn 1, face north and walk around to the back of the wooden building in front of you. Face west and walk over to the closest red toilet. The phantom's corpse is inside the toilet; however, the door does not open, so you need to go around to the right-hand side of the toilet and collect the mask through one of the gaps in the wall.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location, turn left and follow the road until you get to the white number 7 sign on your right. Face south-east and walk over to the picnic benches. The phantom's corpse will be sitting on the picnic bench in front of you.

spawns.label: Spawn 2
spawns.directions: From Spawn 1, face south and go up the stairs until you reach the World of Corn building. Do not enter the building. Turn right and follow the building around; the phantom's corpse will be in the wheelbarrow, under the stairs, on the corner of the building.

spawns.label: Spawn 3
spawns.directions: From Spawn 2, face west and run straight until you reach the playground. Keep heading west until you are standing in the car park on the other side of the playground. The phantom's corpse will be leaning against the end of the car that is closest to the playground.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: Climb to the top of the lookout tower, exit onto the balcony, turn left, and the phantom's corpse will be at your feet.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location, run straight down the hill and stop at the rack of drying animal skins against the back of the cabin in front of you. Walk around the cabin until you find the front door; the phantom's corpse is leaning against the chest of drawers in front of you.

spawns.label: Spawn 2
spawns.directions: From Spawn 1, exit the cabin and turn west. Walk over to the cabin on the left, enter, and follow it around to the end; the phantom's corpse is on the top bunk of the first bunk bed on your left.

spawns.label: Spawn 3
spawns.directions: From Spawn 2, exit the cabin and face north. Walk over to the cabin on your left but don't enter — walk around the outside of the building and the phantom's corpse is in a wheelbarrow near the wall.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: The phantom's corpse is at the top of the lookout tower, on the balcony.

spawns.label: Spawn 2
spawns.directions: If you're feeling really brave, from Spawn 1 face west and jump off the lookout tower. Otherwise climb down and face west, then walk forward until you see the single cabin on your left with a wooden tower behind it. Enter the cabin; the phantom's corpse is leaning against the back wall.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: Requires Lock Pick Skill Level 1. From the spawn-in location, run forward and follow the road until you reach the red and white parking bar. Face east and follow the wire fence on your left until you reach the brick guard tower on your left. Unlock the door of the guard tower; the phantom's corpse is behind the door, on your left.

spawns.label: Spawn 2
spawns.directions: From Spawn 1, stand in the doorway and face SE. Walk forward and follow the road up and around to the right. Continue straight until you see the row of portapotties on your left; the phantom's corpse is inside the first toilet.

spawns.label: Spawn 3
spawns.directions: From Spawn 2, face SW and walk forward until you reach the APC/tank. Turn left and enter the first dome shed on your left; the phantom's corpse is leaning against the first bunk bed on your right.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: The phantom's corpse is at the top of the lookout tower, on the balcony. How are you still surprised by this?

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location — we're not going up the tower for once — face NE and run straight until you see the cabin behind the lookout tower. Enter the cabin and turn right; the phantom's corpse is leaning against the wall in front of you.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location, run straight over to the cabins and enter the cabin on the left. The phantom's corpse is on the top bunk bed in the middle of the room.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location, run straight forward and enter the cabin. The phantom's corpse is leaning against the yellow couch, on your left.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location, turn right until you're lined up with the workshop map marker. Run straight towards the workshop and, as you get close, you'll see a jetty on the left and a set of stairs on your right. Head to the jetty on the left and take the stairs to the top. At the top, face north; the phantom's corpse is laying on the green lounge chair.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: The phantom's corpse spawns at the top of the lookout tower, on the balcony. You're welcome.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location, run straight forward and enter the cabin via the front door. Face west, walk forward, and stop at the wooden chairs next to the bar. Turn right and go up the stairs to the second floor. Stop at the top of the stairs and enter the first doorway on your right. The phantom's corpse is sitting on the toilet, experiencing a very, very bad case of explosive diarrhea.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location, run straight, past the orange car, and jump over the stone wall. Keep walking forward towards the playground on the left. Head to the back of the playground; the phantom's corpse is laying on the slide at the end.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location, run straight towards the first cabin. Walk around the cabin until you find the door. Enter the building; the phantom's corpse is leaning against the western wall, next to the TV.

spawns.label: Spawn 2
spawns.directions: From Spawn 1, exit the cabin and face east. Walk over to the second cabin and around the building until you find the doorway. Enter the cabin; the phantom's corpse is on the top bunk bed on the right.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location, face north and run straight, jumping down the rock face, past the red building on your right, and continue forward until you reach the dumpster against the back of the green building. Face east and stop at the bottom of the slide on your left. Walk up the slide from the bottom and you'll spot the phantom's corpse as you climb.

spawns.label: Spawn 2
spawns.directions: From Spawn 1, stand on the phantom's corpse and face north. Walk forward, past the buildings, and stop at the carousel in front of you. Jump the fence and veer left; the phantom's corpse is sitting on one of the horses.

spawns.label: Spawn 3
spawns.directions: From Spawn 2, face north and look slightly left; you'll see the phantom's corpse sitting on the next ride over. Alternatively, walk forward, jump the fence, take a few more steps and jump the next fence; the phantom's corpse is sitting on the blue chair in front of you.

locations.note: I would run ahead and clear the area, then fast travel back to Camp Liberty to put you back at the spawn-in location — it makes it easier to follow the directions to each corpse.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location, turn right and follow the stone wall straight until you reach the golf cart at the end on your left. The phantom's corpse is inside the golf cart.

spawns.label: Spawn 2
spawns.directions: From Spawn 1, face north and run back out to the main road. Turn right and follow the road to the camp. Enter the camp and stop at the totem pole in the middle. Turn right and continue to follow the path up until you reach the small wooden building with the red door at the end. Enter the building, and the phantom's corpse is sitting on the black couch on your left.

spawns.label: Spawn 3
spawns.directions: From Spawn 2, turn around and run back to the totem pole in the middle of the camp. From the totem pole, face north and follow the path past the rock, then turn right. Follow the path east, past the bonfire, until you reach a small wooden building on your left. The phantom's corpse is inside the building, on the chair behind the desk.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location, run forward and head over to the bathroom block on your left. Enter the building via the first door on your left, and the body will be on the toilet.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location, run straight and stop at the rock in the middle of the area. Jump on top of the rock and face north-west. Walk over to the blue trailer in front of you, and the phantom's corpse will be in the back of the trailer.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location, face east and run forward — either jumping over the fences or running around the long way — until you are at the bottom of the ramp. Face east again and you will see a building on your right. Jump over the hedge and continue walking forward, go up the stairs, take a few steps forward, and enter the building via the door on your right. Stop in the doorway and look right; you will see the phantom's corpse on the ground on your right.

spawns.label: Spawn 2
spawns.directions: Turn around and exit the building. Turn right and follow the deck to the very end. Turn left so you are facing the water. Walk straight, jump over the railing and the walls, and keep walking straight until you are standing next to the gazebo on the edge of the water. The phantom's corpse will spawn inside.

spawns.label: Spawn 3
spawns.directions: Stand inside the gazebo and face north; you will see a vertibird on top of the hill in front of you. Run, swim, jump, or fly over to the vertibird on the hill. Stop at the orange forklift just before the vertibird and face north. Walk over to the green trailer in front of you and enter via the doorway in the middle. Turn right and follow the trailer to the end, and the phantom's corpse will be on the ground at the end.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location, run straight forward, through the gates, and stop at the last cabin on the right. Turn right, enter the cabin, and walk straight to the back wall. Face north-east; the phantom's corpse is leaning against the wall in front of you.

spawns.label: Spawn 2
spawns.directions: From Spawn 1, turn and exit the building, stopping in the doorway. Turn left and follow the cabin to the end. Turn left again and follow the path forward until you hit the rock face. Turn right and walk forward until you hit the wooden fence. Turn left, walk up the hill, and stop at the first cabin on your left. Enter the cabin marked Bunkhouse Phoenix; the phantom's corpse is in a pile of trees, near the back wall.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location, run forward and kill the Yao Guai, then continue straight along the road until you reach the lookout tower. Climb the tower — the phantom's corpse didn't even make it to the top this time.

spawns.label: Spawn 2
spawns.directions: From Spawn 1, climb back down the tower and stop at the bottom of the stairs. Face south and run over to the cabin in front of you. Turn left and follow the cabin around to the front. Go up the stairs and enter the cabin. Walk straight until you hit the back wall, then turn right. Walk straight into the bathroom; the phantom's corpse is laying in the bottom of the shower.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: Continuing from the Dolly Sods Lookout cabin bathroom (its Spawn 2, above), exit the bathroom and walk straight through the kitchen and out the back door. Stop at the bottom of the stairs and face south. Walk forward for a while, past the three white tents on your left, and stop at the campfire — an orange tent should be on your right. Face the orange tent; the phantom's corpse is against the back wall.

spawns.label: Spawn 2
spawns.directions: From Spawn 1, exit the tent and walk forward, drop off the cliff, and stop when you reach the covered picnic-table area on your right. Face south and you'll see the phantom's corpse on the last picnic table on the right.

spawns.label: Spawn 3
spawns.directions: From Spawn 2, face south-east and walk forward until you see a green tent on your left. Stop at the tent, turn left, and the phantom's corpse is inside the tent at the back.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: The phantom's corpse is on the balcony at the top of the lookout tower. I don't know why you're surprised at this.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location, turn left, walk forward a few steps, then turn right into the car park. Follow the car park around to the diner part of the building. Enter via the red door and turn left. Two phantom corpses are in the first booth in front of you.

spawns.label: Spawn 2
spawns.directions: The second phantom's corpse shares that same first booth — seated directly across the table from the first (both are pictured above).

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location, walk forward and follow the path until you reach the green and white striped awning. Face east and follow the row of blue shipping containers on your left to the end. Don't climb up onto the trailer — go around it and stop at the end. Face north and walk forward a few steps, then turn left; the phantom's corpse is inside the shipping container.

spawns.label: Spawn 2
spawns.directions: Requires Lock Pick Skill Level 1. From Spawn 1, exit the container and turn right. Turn right again and follow the path back to the green and white striped awning. Face south and enter the building via the double doorway. Turn east and follow the stairs to the bottom. Unlock the door, walk down the stairs and turn left. Follow the room around to the bathroom at the end; the phantom's corpse is inside the toilet cubicle.

spawns.label: Spawn 3
spawns.directions: From Spawn 2, turn around, go back up the stairs and stop at the green and white striped awning. Face south and walk forward, through the building and out into the courtyard on the other side, stopping at the red shipping containers. Face east and walk forward, keeping the small shed on your right. Keep going, past the generator, and drop down to the path below. Face south and follow the stairs to the bottom; the phantom's corpse is sitting on a toilet on your left.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location, walk forward and enter the car park of the Hemlock Holes Diner. Face south and walk towards the doors of the diner; the phantom's corpse will be on the back of the ute on your right.

spawns.label: Spawn 2
spawns.directions: From Spawn 1, enter the diner and turn left. Walk forward; the phantom's corpse is in the second booth on your left.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location, face west and walk over to the cabin with the green door. Enter the building and follow the room around to the end; the phantom's corpse is sitting on the couch at the end.

spawns.label: Spawn 2
spawns.directions: From Spawn 1, exit the building, face north, and turn left when you are standing back on the road. Follow the road past the second cabin and stop at the back of the third cabin. Face south-west and you will see the phantom's corpse sitting on a crate, leaning against the back wall of the cabin.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location, face south and walk towards the wooden lookout tower. Stop at the start of the tree-trunk ramp, but don't go up the ramp. Face south, walk forward, and stop at the edge of the cliff. You should be looking at a large wooden cabin with its roof missing on the left and right sides. Jump down and walk around to the left of that cabin until you find the door — it should be marked B01 above the door frame. Enter the cabin; the phantom's corpse is leaning against one of the bunk beds at the back.

spawns.label: Spawn 2
spawns.directions: From Spawn 1, exit the cabin and stop at the top of the stairs. Face south-east and walk into the water, stopping at the half-sunken rowboat in front of you. Jump inside the boat and face east; you'll see the phantom's corpse on the raft in front of you, on the white lounge chair.

spawns.label: Spawn 3
spawns.directions: From Spawn 2, face east and swim, jump, or jetpack over to the jetty in front of you. Face north-east and run over to the group of cabins on top of the hill. Face north and walk over to the cabin marked A01 above the doorway. Enter the cabin, follow it around to the end, and you'll see the phantom's corpse sitting on a chair behind the table in the middle of the room.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location, face north and run over to the Lookout Tower. Climb up to the top and exit onto the balcony. Turn left, follow the balcony around, and you will see the phantom's corpse leaning against the railing.

spawns.label: Spawn 1
spawns.directions: From the spawn-in location, run forward and enter the park via the main entrance. Continue forward and stop at the green-and-gold water fountain in the middle. Face north-west and go up the stairs in front of you. Keep walking forward and stop at the second blue bin on your right. Face north and use the bin (or a jetpack) to jump up into the blue tube above you. The phantom's corpse will be inside the zebra cart, to your left.

spawns.label: Spawn 2
spawns.directions: From Spawn 1, face east and follow the blue tube around, through the building and out the other side. Jump off the blue tube onto the ground — if you land in a fenced-off area, hop over that fence. Turn right and walk over to the hot dog sign. Face west and the phantom's corpse will be laying over the bench of the “Knock ’Em Down” arcade game in front of you.

spawns.label: Spawn 3
spawns.directions: From Spawn 2, face east and walk over to the red Ball Toss arcade stand in front of you. With the arcade stand on your right, face north-east and follow the path straight to the Ssslither Slide ride. Keep walking straight until you reach the back of the ride, then take the stairs all the way to the top. The phantom's corpse is inside the first slide on your right.
